SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
Foreign Section.
I. C. D. 534.
Date September 26, 1929

Subject (in full) "Art and Creation" Unification.

Made by D.S. Ovsianikoff. Forwarded by Thos Robertson C.P.I

Sir,

With reference to the attached translation from the
Shanghai Zarya dated September 22, 1929, inquiries go to
show that the Society of "Russian Intellectuals" has decided
to unite together all Russian actors, painters, artists, etc.,
in Shanghai in one organization for mutual assistance and
benefit. Every follower of the above mentioned arts can
become a member of this organization provided that he pays
a member's fee of $1.00, and is not a member of "Rabis"
(workers of Science, Soviet Institution in Harbin), this
organization being strictly anti-Soviet.

At 5 p.m. September 16th. a preliminary meeting of the
organisers was held in the French Concession, during which
time the following persons were elected to serve on the
committee.

A.N. Tolsky, Journalist
P.I. Volpin "
A.I. Chetsky Artist
* V.V. Lorents-Petroff Ballet-dancer (alleged to be "Red")
and
V.M. Ballot Journalist
I.N. Starikoff "
A.A. Osnin "
to serve on the control committee of the organization.

This society also intends to open in the French
Concession a night cabaret under the name "Cottage of Bohein"
where the members of the organization will participate in
performances which will be the main source of income for the
society. It is also reported that in the event of the cabaret

报告

档案编号
上海公共租界工部局警务处
外侨科。
I. C. D. 534。
日期：1929年9月26日

事由（全称）：“艺术与创作”联合会。

撰写人：D.S. Ovsianikoff。转呈人：Thos Robertson，首席警司 (C.P.I)

先生：

关于附上的1929年9月22日《上海朝霞报》(Shanghai Zarya) 译文，经查询显示，“俄罗斯知识分子协会”已决定将在上海的所有俄罗斯演员、画家、艺术家等联合为一个组织，以互助互利。凡从事上述艺术领域者，只要缴纳1.00美元会费，且并非“拉比斯”(Rabis)（即哈尔滨的苏联机构“科学工作者”）的成员，均可加入该组织，因该组织严格反苏。

9月16日下午5时，组织者在法租界举行了一次预备会议，期间选举以下人员担任委员会职务：

A.N. Tolsky，记者
P.I. Volpin，记者
A.I. Chetsky，艺术家
* V.V. Lorents-Petroff，芭蕾舞演员（据称是“赤色分子”）
以及
V.M. Ballot，记者
I.N. Starikoff，记者
A.A. Osnin，记者
担任该组织的监察委员会委员。

该协会还计划在法租界开设一家名为“波希米亚小屋”(Cottage of Bohein) 的夜间歌舞厅，协会成员将参与演出，这将成为该协会的主要收入来源。另据报道，如果该歌舞厅

pages.en:
The "Shanhai Zaryn" of September 22nd writes as follows:-
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE D. FILE No. 534 26.9.29.）

"Art and Creation" Unification.

A new Russian unification to be known as "Art and
Creation" of which artists, painters, actors, etc. will
be admitted as members is in process of formation in
Shanghai and it is intended to establish a Club of that
unification. The preliminary meeting of promoters will
be held on Monday at the "Artists' Club."
pages.zh:
9月22日的《上海朝霞报》(Shanhai Zaryn) 写道：-
（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 D. 档案编号 534 1929年9月26日。）

“艺术与创作”联合会。

一个新的俄罗斯联合体正在上海组建中，名为“艺术与创作”，艺术家、画家、演员等将被接纳为会员，并计划建立该联合会的俱乐部。发起人的预备会议将于星期一在“艺术家俱乐部”举行。
